structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and Boards Within the Department
Cemetery Operators, Perpetual Care Trust Funds and Preneed Burial Contracts

law.catch_line: Application of Part A (§ 64.2-1200 et seq.) of Subtitle IV of Title 64.2
law.text: Trustees appointed pursuant to this chapter shall be governed in their investment of trust funds by § 2.2-4519 and §§ 64.2-1502 through 64.2-1506, except as otherwise provided in this chapter.
